id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|1a0: "Bring me Tockle warriors, and I can send them into the labyrinth from here to explore it.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|264: "If they give up exploring partway or get beaten by monsters and lose heart, they'll leave you, but...
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|33c: "More Tockles willing to help can be gathered quickly, so feel free to send in as many as you like.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|404: "To start, send the six warriors the Elder gave you into the labyrinth and head wherever you please.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|7b0: "Okay then, let the expedition begin! Off you go, and give it your all!
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|970: "If you reset the labyrinth, the treasure chests come back with new contents, but you'll start over from floor 1.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|a3c: "Once you reset it, you can't undo it. Are you sure you want to reset?
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|ac0: "Okay! The reset is complete! The labyrinth's treasure chests should be back now!
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|b70: "Anything else I can do for you?
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|bc0: "Huh? Hero, you don't have anyone to send into the labyrinth. That means you can't go in.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|c78: "You can get more Tockles through StreetPass or by finding them. Gather some, then come back.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|d98: "If you want to explore the labyrinth again, just talk to me anytime.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|fc0: "Keep it up and find the remaining passwords! The Tockles' mission depends on your efforts, Hero!
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|10a: "Congratulations, Hero! You've finally cleared every floor of the labyrinth!
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|114: "And it looks like you've now gathered every password inside the labyrinth! Great work!
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|11e: "...By the way, Hero, now that you have all the Adventure Log passwords, you figured you wouldn't need the labyrinth, right?
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|12e: "But the Labyrinth of Time lives up to its name. You can travel through time and reset it.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|13a: "When you reset the labyrinth, the strangest thing happens: the treasure chests come back.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|143: "The contents change too, so every reset lets you enjoy exploring all over again!
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|14f: "Just be careful: after a reset, you'll start over from floor 1.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|159: "Thanks for all your hard work gathering passwords! Now just restore the Adventure Log world. I'm counting on you!
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|167: "...Oh, but it looks like some Adventure Log passwords still remain in the labyrinth.
id./ui/common_3d.pack|pre_dive_msg.bxon|172: "Unless you gather every password, the Tockles' mission won't be fulfilled. Please keep exploring the labyrinth.
